What Happens When Your Codebase Changes Mid-Spec

Someone else pushed code while you were mid-spec. Now what?
Kiro re-analyzes the codebase and flags affected requirements or tasks.
You get a diff-style view of what changed and what it impacts.
You decide whether to update the spec or the code.

Episode 30 of theAIgurukul's free Kiro series, a daily short on AWS's agentic IDE. Subscribe for the next one.
